resources.string: Smart location-first room discovery & direct owner rentals
Authentication uses Google Sign-In. Email & password sign-in is not enabled on this backend and requires enabling the Email/Password provider in the Firebase Console.

Your RoomFinder account uses Google Sign-In, so password resets are managed securely through Google Account Recovery. Email/password login and reset emails are not enabled on this backend unless you activate the Email/Password provider in the Firebase Console.

RoomFinder collects your Google account display details and only the room/profile details you explicitly submit. Private contact details (email and phone) are stored separately and shared only according to your privacy toggles. Location is read on-demand when you search nearby rooms and is never tracked in the background.

All listings must represent genuine available rooms with accurate pricing and location. Owners are responsible for availability updates; seekers should verify properties during scheduled visits before transferring deposits.
